opportunities.name: Drunken spellblade tank
opportunities.objective: Trade one-shot burst for repeated protected empowered attacks.
opportunities.mechanic: Drunken Rage reduces damage with an AP term and empowers one attack with 0.7 AP plus 7% enemy max-health magic damage. Dusk and Dawn adds a separate attack proc, Riftmaker rewards continued combat, and Visage supports Happy Hour's 5.5% max-health heal. Body Slam's collision reduces its cooldown by 40%, helping create another W window.
opportunities.requiredState: Need E collisions, W timing before contact and Happy Hour availability.
opportunities.failure: Missing E loses the cooldown reduction; W's short protection can expire while chasing.
opportunities.test: Compare W-hit damage, passive healing and E availability across two exchanges at equal gold.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: W's percent-health magic bonus does not multiply separate on-hit item damage.

opportunities.name: Fermented barrel displacement
opportunities.objective: Use a held barrel and R placement to create a larger delayed hit.
opportunities.mechanic: Barrel Roll's 0.8 AP magic damage rises up to 1.5 times as it ages over four seconds. Explosive Cask's 0.8 AP knockback can displace a target toward the prepared barrel; Rocketbelt adjusts the casting angle, while Horizon reveals qualifying long-range ability hits. This is a placement-dependent damage hypothesis rather than an automatic combo.
opportunities.requiredState: Need an aged barrel, a displacement angle and safe range for setup.
opportunities.failure: A wrong R angle ejects the enemy away; detonating Q early sacrifices its multiplier.
opportunities.test: Measure aged-Q damage and successful R-into-Q catches against a moving target, logging range for Horizon.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Every Q detonation is not the full aged damage, and Horizon does not amplify all spells in this source.

ruledOut.reason: Body Slam is AP magic and its collision cooldown reward does not scale from attack speed.

unknowns: Happy Hour internal cooldown is absent from symbolic tooltip; verify separately instead of assuming every cast heals.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Missing E loses the cooldown reduction; W's short protection can expire while chasing.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: W's percent-health magic bonus does not multiply separate on-hit item damage.
Confidence: plausible. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Dusk and Dawn, Riftmaker, Spirit Visage, Abyssal Mask, Cosmic Drive, Mercury's Treads. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

Gragas rolls a cask that explodes after [4] seconds, dealing between [80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage and [(80 / 120 / 160 / 200 / 240 + (0.8) × AP) × (1.5)] magic damage and Slowing for between [40 / 45 / 50 / 55 / 60] and [(40 / 45 / 50 / 55 / 60) × 1.5]% for [2] seconds. The damage and Slow increase with time the cask spent before exploding. 

Gragas can Recast to detonate the cask early.

Gragas charges forward, colliding with the first enemy, Knocking Up nearby enemies for [1] second and dealing [80 / 125 / 170 / 215 / 260 + (0.6) × AP] magic damage to them.

This Ability's Cooldown is reduced by [40]% if Gragas collides with an enemy.
Gragas hurls his cask, dealing [200 / 300 / 400 + (0.8) × AP] magic damage and Knocking Away enemies from the impact zone.
When Gragas uses an Ability, Gragas takes a drink, restoring [(0.055) × Stat(12)] Health.
